'''Etai''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Miner/Legends|Miners]] plumbed the depths of the world's deep caverns in search of the rare, resonant [[Etaan crystal/Legends|etaan crystal]]s, a powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|gemstone]] that was utilized to power [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="EV" />
